summary: community.general's reveal_ansible_type filter and ansible_type test report new Data Tagging aliases such as _AnsibleTaggedStr, _AnsibleTaggedInt and _AnsibleTaggedFloat.
questions: Why does reveal_ansible_type show _AnsibleTaggedStr instead of str?

answer_card.title: Tagged type names in reveal_ansible_type
answer_card.answer_md: With ansible-core's Data Tagging, the community.general `reveal_ansible_type` filter and `ansible_type` test can report new type aliases such as `_AnsibleTaggedStr` (for `str`), `_AnsibleTaggedInt` (for `int`) and `_AnsibleTaggedFloat` (for `float`).
